resetWarning: Reset replaces this demo’s requirements, cases, owned source and run history. Active runs or tasks block reset. Other projects are preserved.
noRequirement: No requirement yet. Describe what needs to be verified; acceptance criteria can be added before or after analysis.
coverageGapCount: {{count}} design or automation coverage gaps remain.
executionMeaning: Execution and pass counts reflect the latest actual bound test results, not unexecuted or subsequently edited code.
contextKept: Current project and entity context retained
criteriaOptionalBeforeAnalysis: No acceptance criteria have been entered. You can ask AI to analyze risks, assumptions, and test scenarios from the requirement first; its output is a proposal, and criteria can be added or refined later.
criteriaEditorHint: Enter one confirmed criterion per line. You can start AI analysis without any criteria.
criteriaPlaceholder: For example: An empty cart shows an empty-state message and a $0.00 total.
providerAnalysisFailed: The AI service returned no usable analysis. Retry or check the provider settings.
providerOutputLimit: The AI output limit was reached before requirement analysis completed. Increase the model or gateway output limit, or shorten the analysis context and retry.
providerEmptyResponse: The AI service ended the request without returning text. Check streaming or JSON compatibility between the model and gateway, then retry.
providerUnavailable: Neither the AI Provider nor a configured fallback returned a result. Check connectivity, authentication, and provider settings, then retry.
invalidStructuredOutput: The AI response did not pass structured requirement analysis validation. Jev was not run and no analysis was applied. Check that the configured model supports JSON output, then retry.
referenceNotice: This is human-authored demo reference material, not a completed AI/Jev invocation. Start analysis to call the configured services.
decisionEvidence: Priority uses linked risks and criteria when available; without criteria it ranks requirement risks.
localFallback: Local fallback; no Jev success claimed.
noAnalysis: No analysis recorded. Start with the requirement description; acceptance criteria can be added later.
previousAnalysisNotice: The latest analysis record did not complete successfully. The summary below is the last saved result, not output from that record.
designIntent: Scenarios organize intent, risk, coverage and oracles. Adoption reuses existing designs.
truncated: The graph reached its projection limit, so only some objects are shown; all coverage ratios are paused.
coverageIncompleteNextStep: Open the knowledge graph to inspect the returned nodes and edges, then focus on a single requirement. Do not treat this partial table as the project-wide denominator until the full graph is available.
noGraphMatches: No matching nodes. Clear the search or filter.
panHint: Drag to pan, or focus the canvas and use arrow keys. Select a node to inspect its sources.
sourceRelationships: Relationships come from persisted entities and real executions.
coverageBasis: Design coverage uses actual AC/rule/risk/flow links. Automation counts only ACTIVE bindings with a nodeid. Execution and pass coverage use each bound case's latest actual pytest result. Ratios are hidden when the graph is incomplete.
latestRunLinkMeaning: Each Run link below points to the latest actual execution for a linked case; different cases may point to different Runs. These links do not represent the Run selected in Workspace.
metricCountIncomplete: Graph is incomplete; ratio not calculated
noDenominator: No valid denominator; 100% coverage cannot be claimed.
dataSource: Data persisted on this case. Automation should load and verify it through project fixtures.
draftNotVerified: Data, actions and oracles are present. Generated code still requires review and real execution.
noRun: Run a test to view its actual live browser and results here.
noTelemetry: No events of this kind were captured.
previewNotice: This is an interactive local shop preview. Run frames come from the actual test browser.
selectCase: No case is linked to the current file. Execution results will still be saved.
noSourceFile: Select a test file before running.
staleAnalysis: Requirement inputs changed. Reanalyze; previous conclusions are historical.
